codeReview.summary: The feature implementation covers the required behavior: TUI pane deletion now updates task.panes and persists via store.save_task, with integration tests validating both in-memory tracking and on-disk persistence. The change in src/tui/app.rs aligns with the command_executor KillPane flow for the normal success path.

issues.description: If store.load_task(task_name) fails, the code silently skips retain/save but still reports success at line 1234 ("Deleted pane: ..."). This leaves task tracking/persistence uncorrected in that error path and gives a misleading status.

summary: Reviewed commit c04fb69 for fix-tui-pane-deletion-tracking. Core behavior is implemented and tested as requested, so the feature passes review. Noted one non-blocking error-path gap where load_task failure is silently ignored before reporting deletion success.
